tasks.instruction: Practice: trace the line and the circle. This one does not count.
Trace the spiral. Start at the dot near the middle. Try not to lift the pencil.
Copy this row of loops in one line. Try not to lift the pencil.
Draw a clock. Put in all the numbers and set the hands to ten past eleven.
Copy this sentence in your usual handwriting.

stimulus.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

tasks.instruction: Operator: measure the bar with a steel rule or an ID card.
Operator: hold the pencil tip still on the dot for 10 seconds.
Operator: draw along the line at an even speed.
